resource.title: Shared care: breast cancer treatment with diabetes and kidney disease
resource.description:
Newly diagnosed early left breast cancer, now excised, in a 72-year-old with type 2 diabetes on basal insulin, stage 2 diabetic kidney disease, and a history of resected stage IV colon cancer (2016, in remission). Mild memory impairment; family very involved.

Plan: adjuvant radiotherapy then letrozole (oncology); GP to monitor glucose closely during treatment - sick day plan given, insulin titration by the diabetes educator; keep renal function stable (no NSAIDs, contrast precautions, metformin hold rules); bone density before letrozole; continue colon cancer surveillance with oncology. Any medication change must go to her pharmacy so the dose administration aid is updated. She is focused on staying well for her grandchildren.

text.div: Wants full active treatment, including resuscitation. Organ donor. Accepts blood transfusion. To be revisited if the cancer recurs.
